description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements a logging utility that wraps around Android's native Log class. It provides a linked-list structure for chaining multiple LogNode implementations, allowing logs to be processed or forwarded through a sequence of nodes.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface, enabling log message processing and chaining.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Prints log data to Android's log system and forwards the log to the next node if present. Handles null message and includes optional throwable information.
